summary.text: Arnold Mooney is a Republican state representative from Alabama House District 43 who took office in November 2014 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election, where Democrat Taylor Cook is also on the ballot. A commercial Realtor, Mooney is a graduate of Samford University.

paragraphs.text: Mooney attended Sidney Lanier High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Samford University.
He works as a commercial Realtor.
Mooney assumed office in the Alabama House on November 5, 2014.

In the 2025-2026 session Mooney chaired the Shelby County Legislation Committee, was vice chair of the Constitution, Campaigns and Elections Committee, and served on the Health Committee and the Ways and Means General Fund Committee.
